MaskStrategy.AUTO: Reuses any precompiled work; otherwise `PARSER_DWA`, or `TOKEN_TRIE` when that would be too large. The default.
MaskStrategy.PARSER_DWA: Builds a parser DWA for the grammar. Slowest to compile, with the fastest masks.
MaskStrategy.TOKEN_TRIE: Computes each mask by walking the vocabulary. Fastest to compile, with slower masks. Pass a `TokenTrie` instead to change its settings.
BoundaryMaskStrategy: How masks are computed at grammar boundaries.
BoundaryMaskStrategy.PARSER_DWA: Builds a parser DWA across each boundary. Slower to compile, with faster masks. Raises `ValueError` if it would be too large.
BoundaryMaskStrategy.AUTO: `PARSER_DWA`, or `TOKEN_TRIE` when that would be too large. The default.
BoundaryMaskStrategy.TOKEN_TRIE: Walks the vocabulary at each boundary as needed. Faster to compile, with slower masks.
ParserBackend: How the parser is represented and run when masks are computed with `MaskStrategy.TOKEN_TRIE`.
ParserBackend.LR_TABLE: An LR table. Faster to compile, with slower masks. The default.
ParserBackend.TEMPLATE_DFA: Template DFAs. Slower to compile, with faster masks.
TokenSet.from_ranges: Creates a set from `range` objects, which must have step 1.
TokenSet.__repr__: An expression that rebuilds the set, or a summary for large sets.
TokenSet.__eq__: Whether both sets contain the same IDs.
Vocab: A model's tokens and their bytes.
Vocab.from_dict:
Creates a vocabulary from a `{token: id}` dict.

`str` tokens are UTF-8 encoded; `bytes` tokens are used as is. `special_token_ids` adds tokens that have no bytes, such as end-of-sequence tokens.
Vocab.from_id_to_bytes:
Creates a vocabulary from an `{id: bytes}` dict.

`special_token_ids` adds tokens that have no bytes, such as end-of-sequence tokens.
Vocab.from_llama_cpp:
Creates a vocabulary from a llama-cpp-python `Llama` model.

Tokens with no text, such as control and end-of-generation tokens, become special tokens.
Vocab.llama_cpp_end_token_ids: The model's end-of-generation token IDs, or an empty list if the vocabulary was not created by `from_llama_cpp`. Put them in a `TokenSet` after the grammar to require one.
Extern: A named placeholder in a grammar.
Extern.name: The extern's name.
Extern.kind: What the extern can be bound to: `"token"` or `"grammar"`.
Extern.__eq__: Whether both have the same name and kind.
Externs:
A grammar's or module's externs, in declaration order.

A read-only mapping from name to `Extern`.
Externs.__getitem__: The extern named `key`. Raises `KeyError` if there is none.
Externs.__iter__: The extern names, in declaration order.
Externs.get: The extern named `key`, or `default` if there is none.
Externs.keys: The extern names, in declaration order.
Externs.__eq__: Whether both list the same externs in the same order.
Expr.choice:
Matches any one of `parts`.

Raises `ValueError` if a part has unbound externs.
Expr.sequence:
Matches `parts` in order.

Raises `ValueError` if a part has unbound externs.
Expr.literal: Matches exactly `value`. A `str` is UTF-8 encoded.
Module: A grammar you can compose with others and partly compile before its externs are bound.
Module.__new__: Creates a module from a grammar.
Module.bind:
Binds the extern `name` to `value`.

`bind(a=x, b=y)` binds several at once; if one fails, none is bound. Raises `ValueError` if a name is undeclared or already bound, or a value is the wrong kind.
Module.precompile:
Compiles as much as possible for `vocab` now, even with externs unbound, so later compiles are faster.

The keyword arguments choose how masks are computed; see `MaskStrategy`, `TokenTrie` and `BoundaryMaskStrategy`.
Module.compile:
Compiles the module for `vocab`, reusing any precompiled work. Every extern must be bound.

The keyword arguments choose how masks are computed; see `MaskStrategy`, `TokenTrie` and `BoundaryMaskStrategy`.
Module.copy: A copy of the module. Binding the copy does not change the original.
Module.save: Saves the module as bytes, with its precompiled work but without the vocabulary. Bytes saved by one GLRMask version may not load in another.
Module.load: Loads a module saved with `save()`. Its precompiled work only applies to the vocabulary it was built for; compiling with another is an error.
Grammar: A grammar, written as source text or built from an `Expr`.
Grammar.from_glrm: Creates a grammar from GLRM source.
Grammar.from_json_schema: Creates a grammar from a JSON Schema, given as JSON text or a JSON-compatible object such as a dict.
Grammar.from_lark: Creates a grammar from Lark source.
Grammar.precompile:
Compiles as much as possible for `vocab` now, even with externs unbound, and returns a `Module` that keeps the work.

The keyword arguments choose how masks are computed; see `MaskStrategy`, `TokenTrie` and `BoundaryMaskStrategy`.
Grammar.compile:
Compiles the grammar for `vocab`.

The keyword arguments choose how masks are computed; see `MaskStrategy`, `TokenTrie` and `BoundaryMaskStrategy`.
Grammar.copy: A copy of the grammar. Binding the copy does not change the original.
Constraint: A grammar compiled for a vocabulary.
Constraint.start: A new state with nothing committed.
Constraint.mask_len: The number of `int32` words that `fill_mask` needs.
Constraint.save:
Saves the constraint as bytes, without the vocabulary.

Bytes saved by one GLRMask version may not load in another.
Constraint.load: Loads a constraint saved with `save`. `vocab` must be the one it was compiled for, or loading raises `ValueError`.
ConstraintState.mask:
The tokens allowed next, as a Boolean array indexed by token ID.

`size` sets the array length, for example to match your logits; it must cover every token ID.
ConstraintState.fill_mask:
Writes the mask into `bitmask`, zeroing any extra words. `bitmask` must be a contiguous, writable 1-D `int32` array of at least `Constraint.mask_len()` words.

Token `id` is allowed when bit `id % 32` of word `id // 32` is set.
ConstraintState.commit_token: Commits a token. Returns `False` if it is not allowed, which terminates the state.
ConstraintState.commit_tokens: Commits each token in order. Returns `False` at the first one that is not allowed, which terminates the state.
ConstraintState.commit_bytes: Commits raw bytes. Returns `False` if they are not allowed, which terminates the state.
ConstraintState.is_accepting: Whether the input so far is a complete match.
ConstraintState.is_terminated: Whether no more input can be accepted.
ConstraintState.forced_tokens: Tokens for what must come next, taking the longest token at each step. Stops before anything that could vary, or at 10,000 tokens or bytes.
Grammar.from_expr: Creates a grammar from an expression.
Grammar.bind:
Binds the extern `name` to `value`.

`bind(a=x, b=y)` binds several at once; if one fails, none is bound. Raises `ValueError` if a name is undeclared or already bound, or a value is the wrong kind.
TokenTrie:
Settings for `MaskStrategy.TOKEN_TRIE`. Pass one as `mask_strategy`.

`TokenTrie()` is the same as `MaskStrategy.TOKEN_TRIE`.
TokenTrie.parser_backend: How the parser is represented. Defaults to `ParserBackend.LR_TABLE`.
TokenTrie.merge_equivalent_tokens:
Whether tokens that the grammar treats the same are merged, so masks walk fewer tokens. Defaults to `False`.

Tokens are not merged in a composition that includes precompiled parts.
